verdict.rationale: Ente Auth's end-to-end encrypted cloud sync means codes appear on any device where you sign in, which covers the core of moving to a new phone. Password-protected local backups offer a second route for offline users. However, no doc describes a dedicated new-phone flow or confirms it is a single guided step. Missing for 10: documented device-migration walkthrough, explicit confirmation that signing in on a new phone restores all tokens in one step, a guided transfer path for offline-mode users, and hands-on corroboration of phone-to-phone migration.

support.subject: As an everyday user, moving to a new phone transfers all my tokens in one guided step

citations.quote: Your codes sync across all your devices, end-to-end encrypted.
Auth provides end-to-end encrypted cloud backups so you don't have to worry about losing your tokens.
In offline mode, your codes are stored only on that device.
All local backups are encrypted with a password you set.
